steps.name: Radical Mafioso
steps.text: No one told me about this!

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Me neither.

steps.name: Radical Mafioso
steps.text: Did she act on her own?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I chose to let her do it.

steps.name: Radical Mafioso
steps.text: Don Alberto! But why?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: A gold coin can mean very different things in different circumstances.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: The Bellones will not have their way.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: What's a little smirch on our reputation, if it means we cut another piece of flesh off Bernardo?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: What should we do now?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Prepare my car. I'm going to see my daughter.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Yes, Don Alberto.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: By the way, where is Danbrown now?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Danbrown? I think he's working at a carwash.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Give me the address.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Are you calling him back?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I never permitted him to leave the famiglia.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And prepare a banquet.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: For...?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: A feast for the heir to Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Let me go!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: We caught the assassins, thanks to Lappland's tip-off.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: They've been identified as having taken part in Leontuzzo's assassination.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Do you two know her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Nothing good ever comes of dealing with you, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look on the bright side. It's not every day that you get to sit in a Siracusan cell.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Lock them up.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Yes, Your Honor.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You were the one who waylaid Cellinia, and ordered the bombing of Carracci...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Is that still your story?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You sure are persistent, aren't you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't you and Bellone want to get this case closed as quickly as you can?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Does it matter if it was me or Texas who did it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You really should hang me, Your Honor.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm just a pawn my famiglia cast aside. Surely, you can do it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Imagine the positive impact that my death will have on justice in Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Isn't it worth a try?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I don't know what you're planning.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But I'll do exactly that, if you really are the culprit, Lappland Saluzzo.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: First, there's someone I have to see.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Welcome back, Don Bernardo.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Take a break. You've been working hard.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Yes, Don Bernardo.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Not happy?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: How could I be?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: There are some things that you have to know.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Why did you bring me here?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: My lord.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Bernardo. Are you asking me to tame your unruly cub now?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: He just needs to understand something.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What are you—

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I am il Signore dei Lupi, cub.
Leontuzzo feels a daze at the words 'Signore dei Lupi'.
Fragments of knowledge and memory rush into his mind and take shape.
The Signori dei Lupi. Sovereign of beasts.
Beings that were never born. They have existed since time immemorial.
Zaaro is a sovereign of beasts.
He and his kind have borne witness to the path that the wolfpack tread on the wildness.
They are engaged in a killing game, guided by their own nature.
The Signori dei Lupi are immortal.
They gain no satisfaction from fighting amongst themselves, so they have set rules for their game.
Each Signore dei Lupi grooms a human to hunt the others.
These are the Fangs of the Signore dei Lupi.
The one with the last Fang standing becomes the alpha.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Signore dei Lupi, the hunt, Fangs...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Could it be...?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Your father has been an excellent Fang.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Rubio, Don Alberto is holding a banquet for Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: We'll need the best food.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Could it really be Saluzzo?

steps.name: Saluzzo Mafioso
steps.text: Rubio?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Oh, it's nothing.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Let me think... ordinary hospitality won't do when the Bellones are involved.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Please inform Don Alberto that it would be my honor to prepare the banquet, personally.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I eagerly await his response.
In Columbia, a show of kindness by a mafioso often results in the subject becoming a chip in a bargain.
The more one cares, the higher the cost.
In Siracusa, the subject may take their last breath on a dark, rainy street.
The more one cares, the greater the pain.
One must become cold and heartless.
Texas knows that well, and detests it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No need to apologize to me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You can leave after some paperwork, if you want.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Procedurally, you're no longer a suspect.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm not worried. It's quieter here in jail.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Haven't you given up yet?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Do you really think your old friend did it?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's her style, but I don't see the motive.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Then it's not time to give up.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia, Famiglia Rossati sends word that Signor Wallach would like to speak with Signorina Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Well... no rest for the wicked, then.
Lavinia realizes that Texas put something in her pocket as she passed by.
She reaches into it and finds a note.
There is a phone number and a short message scribbled in a corner:
'Penguin Logistics delivers, rain or shine.'

steps.name: Unhappy Audience Member
steps.text: Signor, if you have to sleep, can you at least put your legs down?
...Hmm?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Are you talking to me?

steps.name: Unhappy Audience Member
steps.text: Who else? How could you sleep in the theater?

steps.name: Unhappy Audience Member
steps.text: And to put your feet up like that! How rude!

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I'm not blocking you, am I?

steps.name: Unhappy Audience Member
steps.text: No, but it's really off-putting to have someone so rude beside me!

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Alright, I'll put my legs down.

steps.name: Unhappy Audience Member
steps.text: Hey, why do you have food with you?

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: We don't sell food here.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Yeah, I bought it at the corner store, since you don't sell popcorn here.

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: Is it your first time here?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: A friend suggested I come here to relax.

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: What do you think of the performance?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I don't really understand what's going on.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Why are they doing that?

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: Escort this gentleman out.

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: He's not welcome here.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Hey, I bought a ticket!

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: Give him a refund.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Right away.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Come with us, signor.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: And get the hell out.

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: Say, I saw him when the show started.

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: I thought he was some rich boy out to experience society.

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: Turns out it was a poor cazzo who knows nothing about opera.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Did you like what they were doing on stage?

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Of course. The actors looked nice.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: And the songs were beautiful.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Is that what they call 'art'?

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Stick to the bars, pleb.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Oh yeah, here's your ticket money.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Don't you dare say we took it.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: What's that? You wanna do this the hard way?

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: Hey, this guy's strong.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: I need some help here!

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: Something's not right with his eyes.

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: A-Aaaahh! My arm! It's gonna break!

steps.name: Flippant Security Guard
steps.text: H-Hold it right there!

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: Just let it go, don't waste your time with a cazzo like that.

steps.name: Harsh Security Guard
steps.text: C'mon, let's get you bandaged up.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Sorry, Signorina Lavinia...

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Doesn't look like this is something for me.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Guess I should find a bar to get myself drunk, then spend the night at the porno theater.
Want a drink?
Danbrown looks in the direction the voice came from.
He sees a man leaning by the side of the alley, shaking a bottle in his hand.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I want an explanation, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Isn't this what you wanted?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Help the Bellones when they're at their weakest, control them, and dominate them, rather than destroy them.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I thought I taught you.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I taught you what to do in times like this.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh, I forgot. It's been years since I left, you know.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I can have you ignoring the business I give you, or you going against me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You're my daughter, after all.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I'm a forgiving man, but I can't let you go over my head to make decisions for the famiglia.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Even if you did actually guess what I wanted to do.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I am don of our famiglia.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Seven years ago, I kicked you out for this. Seven years later, you came back and did it again.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You knew it would infuriate me. You knew it was the only thing that could infuriate me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Why did you do it, figlia mia?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Because nothing else brings me joy, padre mio.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I wanted to know if it's really your position that matters most.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I've always wanted to know.
Lappland raises herself from the ground with great effort.
Her face is full of joy, as though this was what she came back to Siracusa for.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Time's up, boss.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: That'll be all for today.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You defied me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But you're still my daughter.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You know what I want, better than anyone.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: All you're missing is discipline.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: It's my fault for not educating you properly.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But there's still time.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So all the Signori dei Lupi live amongst us?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: No, he's the only one who involves himself in human society.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: The rest of them stay out in the wildness.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: He believes that the authority over man is a form of power.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And he wants to use it to triumph over the other Signori dei Lupi.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So he wants you to overthrow Signora Sicilia, become the de facto ruler of Siracusa, and help him win his fight with his kind?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You, me, the entire famiglia, we're all tools to him.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Did you think I was going to accept that?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: How could you accept being a puppet your entire life?!

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Figlio mio, there's one thing you've misunderstood.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: He taught me how to win power, just as I taught you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Using it to defeat the other Fangs is just a part.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Every decision that I made, including what I'm doing now, is my own.

a.text: How can you be so sure?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: (No, he's serious.)

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: (Look at him, the strength of his character, he's no puppet.)

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: We're each other's tools, instruments for our mutual victory. That's all.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Boss, the Saluzzos have sent their invitation.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Don Alberto would like Signor Leon to attend his banquet.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've lost count of how many times you sighed today, Sora.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Can't be helped, considering what happened at the trial.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: How about we raid the prison?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya lost yer darned mind?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: At least we'd get to see her.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I wouldn't recommend it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What are you doing here, Miss Caterina?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: That's my line, Sora. Why are you out here? It's dangerous.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I live nearby.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: You do? Did you get scammed?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's fine, she's got me n' Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Who's this, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, I met Caterina a few days ago over at the theater.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Well... I guess it's fine, if you have friends you can count on.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Oh, don't worry about me. A noisy place like this is conductive to my creative work.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Creative work... say, the playwright behind La Morte di Texas is named Caterina too. Could you be...?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wow! No wonder you knew so much about the Texas Family!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I read that one! Even I could tell it's one humdinger of a script!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Can I get yer autograph?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Sure. Not that it's worth anything right now.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Le Morty de Texas is gonna be a blockbuster! You'n bet on that!

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Back to what you just said...

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: You look like you can take care of yourselves, and I wouldn't put it past you to actually get it done, if it was any other Siracusan prison.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: But things aren't so easy here in Volsinii, with Lavinia around.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: The eyes of all the famiglie are on that place. You don't know what trouble you might stir up, if you act rashly.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Heh, we were just kiddin' around.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: You didn't look like you were.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: May I ask a question?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Do you know Cellinia well?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Sit.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: There's an unwritten rule in art and writing.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You can base your work on the famiglia, but you can't mention a real famiglia by name.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I've heard that.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: But somebody put 'La Morte di Texas' out there.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: The first work to use the name of a real famiglia.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: That means the famiglie aren't trying to stay in the shadows anymore. They're out to take center stage.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: All thanks to the Columbians.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: A lot's changed since the Columbians got mixed up in the Siracusan art scene.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Unscrupulous artists—or rather, craftsmen—pumped out work that's starting to stink.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: They're not making observations about life, they're making pale imitations of it. As long as audiences are willing to shell out money for it.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: It's just a mosaic of pop culture. What was popular yesterday shows up in theaters tomorrow.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Real quality is buried under garbage, which becomes all you find when you look for art.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Isn't that terrible?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: If it's what everybody likes, then what you call 'art' sounds like garbage.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Some think like that, but not everyone.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: There are those who would like to keep good art from being buried, but they don't know how to fight the tide.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: That old timey opera didn't appeal to me.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: But you never escaped the past, did you?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Benthonexigios. You'll find my name in the reviews section of Volsinii Arts Weekly.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Ben...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Just call me Ben.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Ben...

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I... I've got my thoughts about what Siracusa's become.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: People up high say we oughta solve our problems in more civilized ways.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: But when I try to do something all civilized, things turn out the same as they always did.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Why do we fool ourselves like that, when we don't actually have to?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: The famiglie know how things are trending, but no one wants to give what they already had.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Want a drink?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: That wine's not cheap.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: It's not.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: And this is a cheap pizzeria.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Why pair a wine like that with pizza like that?

spans.text: Why pair a wine like that with pizza like

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Because the wine is worth the same as the pizza to me.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: The wine is certainly finely made, but just as much care was put into growing the wheat that ended up in this pizza.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Is there really that much of a difference in value between them, if you take away the trappings of civilization?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Do you believe in these things?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: The trappings of civilization?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Like the label on this wine. Slap it on something, and you're free to feed on the people whom you've fooled.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: So Cellinia fled to Lungmen, and you are her friends...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hard to believe, isn't it?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: No, I believe it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: First, there's no need for you to lie. Second, I always thought there was a chance she was still alive.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Now I understand why she suddenly showed up.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I guess she made a deal with the Bellones, and now she's here to pay her debt.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Definitely sounds like her.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: But what a coincidence it is that you found the Compagnia dell'alba... (whispers) or perhaps it's no coincidence...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What's special about that company?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Nothing. It's nothing.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: The Compagnia dell'alba is a good place to start, if you want to get close to Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: But... well, come with me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's this place...?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: It's my home.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wow, books and papers everywhere.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Haha, sorry about that. I didn't have time to clean up.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Take this, Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: A key?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Yes. It can be dangerous outside. Come here, if you want to practice.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: It's quieter, and I have plenty of scripts you can look at.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Just think of it as making a new friend.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Alright!
